feature_notes: Files line regex (the thing that makes a body a merge note): ^(\d+) files? \(\+(\d+) −(\d+)\) landed on `([^`]+)` from `([^`]+)`\.$ - note the U+2212 minus sign and the backticked target and branch; without a match parse returns nil and the caller keeps the generic popover

Head line regex: ^- (.+?) \((\d+)\): (.*?) — (?:no files|(\d+) files?: (.*))$ - name, persona index, task, em dash separator, then either the literal 'no files' or a count and a comma-space separated file list
Parsing: a line exactly equal to 'Heads' starts the heads section; a blank line ends it; a non '- ' line ends it too; only the first files line is taken (match == nil guard)
A line ending in 'is up to date.' is dropped as not a note; every other leftover line becomes a note with all backticks stripped
Open button title by forge: 'Open merge request' for .gitlab, 'Open pull request' for .github and .gitea
Copy link is guarded against re-entry while didCopyLink is true; the Copied state lasts 1.4 s
Each head face carries its own popover so the card hangs from the face under the cursor; hover sets hoveredHead and clears it only if it is still that head

MergeRequestLink.label's exact content (e.g. '#123' vs a title) is defined elsewhere

side_effects: Task.sleep(for: .seconds(rise + 0.1)) twice: one task to mark isSettled after a head stops, one to end isRising after a new stave
SweepBudget.shared.join / leave on isRunning changes and onDisappear
TimelineView animation clocks at 1/24 s (bar) and 1/20 s (title), paused by reduce motion, settling, or ScrollActivity.shared.isScrolling
platform_assumptions: AppKit: NSWorkspace accessibilityDisplayShouldReduceMotion
SwiftUI Canvas/GraphicsContext with clip and linearGradient fills, TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval:paused:)) and TimelineView(.periodic(from:by:))
onContinuousHover(coordinateSpace: .local) - a pointer-based macOS interaction with no touch equivalent
macOS glass (.glassEffect(.regular, in:)) for the hover card unless already on a glass panel
ui_elements: Bar metrics: height 28, staveWidth 3, gap 3, pitch 6 (staveWidth + gap); capacity = max(1, floor((width + gap) / pitch))
Timings: rise 0.45 s (ease-out cubic 1 - pow(1 - t, 3)), sweep 2.6 s, sweepRest 3.4 s, clock 1/24 s; sweepSlots 3
Stave height shares: lookup 0.45, command 0.65, edit 0.85, reply 1

Stave colours: edit and reply full tint, command tint.opacity(0.7), lookup tint.opacity(0.4); a failed head's last stave is Chrome.danger, a stopped head's last stave Chrome.secondaryText; the hovered stave is overpainted .white.opacity(0.4)
Empty slots: height bottom * 0.45, filled Chrome.overlay(0.06), drawn for indices staves.count..<capacity

Sweep band: width max(24, filledWidth / 3) where filledWidth = count * pitch - gap; clipped to the filled path; linear gradient white 0 -> white 0.55 -> white 0; x = -band + phase * (filledWidth + band)

Hover card: width 260, HStack spacing 8, MCPGlyph size 14 or SF symbol .system(size: 12, weight: .semibold) secondary in a 14-wide frame, step text .system(size: 13, weight: .semibold) primary lineLimit 1 truncation .tail; padding horizontal 12 / vertical 10; ProgressCardSurface at Chrome.cardCornerRadius; padding(.bottom, 8) in a zero-height bottom-aligned frame; x clamped to [0, width - 260]; allowsHitTesting(false); transition .opacity; animation .smooth(duration: 0.15) on hoveredIndex

Counts line: '3 edits · 2 commands · 5 reads' at .system(size: 11) Chrome.secondaryText, centred (frame(maxWidth: .infinity)), hidden when empty; accessibility sentence joins with ', ' and reads 'Nothing done yet' when empty
Accessibility label: '<counts sentence>, <elapsed>' plus ' so far' while running
HydraHeadProgress: VStack(spacing: 0) between two Spacer(minLength: 0), title then bar with .padding(.top, 10), padding horizontal 20 and top HydraPanel.stripHeight

HydraWorkingTitle: text .system(size: 13, weight: .medium), lineLimit 2, default alignment .center; sweep 3.2 s, sweepRest 3.0 s, breath 3.2 s, reach 0.3, clock 1/20 s; gradient dips to Chrome.primaryText.opacity(0.6) at the band centre; opacity 0.86 + 0.14 * breath where breath = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(now / 3.2 * 2 * pi)
HydraElapsedTime: .system(size: 11).monospacedDigit() Chrome.secondaryText, ticking every 1 s from startedAt while running
feature_notes: Stave kinds from tool calls: .edit kind -> edit; .command kind -> command unless call.edits is non-empty, then edit; any other kind -> lookup unless call.edits is non-empty, then edit; an assistant message becomes a reply stave
Reply stave label: TextCleanup.singleLine of only the first 600 characters, limit 60, rendered as 'Replied: <words>' or plain 'Replied' when empty; symbol 'bubble.left'
Tool stave label is ToolPresentation.label(for: call); its mark is the MCP server's glyph when ToolPresentation.mcpParts(call) resolves, otherwise ToolPresentation.symbol(for: call.kind)
Overflow: when events exceed capacity only the latest `capacity` staves are drawn (events.suffix), so the oldest slide off the left
StaveCache keys each entry by ObjectIdentifier plus, for tool rows, call.status and call.title, and compares in place without allocating; a capacity change also invalidates
Drawing batches one fill per stave kind into a shared Path to avoid per-stave dynamic colour resolution; only the ending stave (failed/stopped) and the hovered stave are filled separately
The clock runs only when !reduceMotion && !isSettled && (has a sweep slot || a stave is rising), and is additionally paused whenever ScrollActivity.shared.isScrolling
Only the first 3 running bars sweep (SweepBudget.sweepSlots); a bar takes a freed slot as soon as one opens because SweepBudget is @Observable
Hover picks index = floor(point.x / pitch) but only when 0 <= y <= 28 and x >= 0, and names nothing past the filled staves
HydraHeadProgress falls back to head.title when the task is blank and to HydraRoster.persona(at: 0) when there is no head info
unresolved_questions: ToolPresentation.label/symbol/mcpParts and the full ToolCall.Kind case list are defined outside this bundle, so the exact per-kind symbols are not knowable here
The hover card's step for a stave that has slid off the left is index-based on the visible staves; whether ToolPresentation labels can be empty (leaving a bare card) is not determinable here
Chrome.cardCornerRadius and Chrome.panelControlFill values are defined elsewhere
